## Load Avatar Inference Data

```{r}

read_json_meta <- function(json_path) {
  meta <- jsonlite::read_json(json_path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
  list(
    session  = meta$session,
    player   = meta$player,
    round    = meta$round,
    emotions = as.character(meta$emotions)
  )
}

msgpk_stream_to_tibble_safe <- function(msgpk_path) {

  json_path <- sub("\\.msgpk$", ".json", msgpk_path)
  if (!file.exists(json_path)) {
    message("[MISSING JSON] ", msgpk_path)
    return(NULL)
  }

  meta <- tryCatch(read_json_meta(json_path), error = function(e) {
    message("[BAD JSON] ", msgpk_path, " | ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
  if (is.null(meta)) return(NULL)

  f <- builtins$open(msgpk_path, "rb")
  on.exit(f$close(), add = TRUE)
  u <- msgpack$Unpacker(f, raw = FALSE)

  f$seek(0L, 2L); size <- as.numeric(f$tell()); f$seek(0L, 0L)

  ts    <- list()
  sm    <- list()
  ema   <- list()   # <-- add
  spont <- list()   # <-- add
  pr    <- list()

  last_pos <- -1
  i <- 0L

  get_num_or_na <- function(x, key) {
    v <- x[[key]]
    if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0L || is.na(v)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(v)
  }

  repeat {
    pos <- as.numeric(u$tell())
    if (pos <= last_pos || pos >= size) break
    last_pos <- pos

    x <- tryCatch(u$unpack(), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(x)) break

    if (!is.list(x)) next
    if (is.null(x$timestamp) || is.null(x$probs)) next

    i <- i + 1L
    ts[[i]]    <- as.numeric(x$timestamp)
    sm[[i]]    <- get_num_or_na(x, "avatarSmile")
    ema[[i]]   <- get_num_or_na(x, "EMA")
    spont[[i]] <- get_num_or_na(x, "Spont")
    pr[[i]]    <- as.numeric(x$probs)
  }

  if (i == 0L) {
    message("[CORRUPTED MSGPK] ", msgpk_path)
    return(NULL)
  }

  timestamp_raw <- unlist(ts, use.names = FALSE)
  avatarSmile   <- unlist(sm, use.names = FALSE)
  EMA           <- unlist(ema, use.names = FALSE)
  spontSmile    <- unlist(spont, use.names = FALSE)
  probs_mat     <- do.call(rbind, pr)

  timestamp <- timestamp_raw

  colnames(probs_mat) <- meta$emotions

  tibble(
    session     = as.numeric(meta$session),
    player      = meta$player,
    round       = as.numeric(meta$round),
    file        = msgpk_path,
    timestamp   = timestamp,
    avatarSmile = avatarSmile,
    EMA         = EMA,
    spontSmile  = spontSmile
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(as_tibble(probs_mat))
}
```

## Fix clocks

For sessions 1–15, we reconstructed recording times by anchoring elapsed time since the first recorded frame to the UTC start time embedded in each filename. We applied the estimated terminal/session clock correction and expressed timestamps in seconds relative to the central round start. Because this reconstruction omits the interval between initialization and the first recorded frame, we shifted these timestamps by the difference in median recording onset between earlier and later sessions, aligning their medians.

```{r}

inferenceData <- bind_rows(inference_list)

dataAvatar <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataAvatar.rds")

inferenceData <- inferenceData %>%
  left_join(
    dataAvatar %>%
      dplyr::select(
        session, player, round, terminal, roundStart, roundEnd, roundTime, agreement, experimental
      )
    ,
    by = c("session", "player", "round")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    avatarSmile = ifelse(
      avatarSmile < 0.15, 0.15, avatarSmile
    )
  )

inferenceData <- inferenceData %>%
  left_join(
    readRDS("../Datasets/dataOffsetTerminal.rds"),
    by = c("session", "terminal")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    session, player, terminal, round, timestamp, roundTime, roundStart, roundEnd, agreement, medianClockOffset, meanClockOffset, avatarSmile, EMA, spontSmile, Neutral, Happy, Sad, Surprise, Fear, Disgust, Angry, experimental, file
  )

post15 <- inferenceData %>%
  dplyr::filter(session > 15) %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = timestamp + medianClockOffset
  )

startStatsPost <- post15 %>%
  group_by(session, player, round) %>%
  summarise(
    start = first(timestamp)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    meanStart = mean(start, na.rm=TRUE),
    medianStart = median(start, na.rm=TRUE),
  )

medianStartPost <- startStatsPost %>%
  pull(medianStart)

pre15 <- inferenceData %>%
  dplyr::filter(session <= 15) %>%
  group_by(session, player, round, timestamp) %>%
  summarise(
    nReps = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, round) %>%
  arrange(timestamp, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    diffTs = lead(timestamp) - timestamp,
    diffTs = coalesce(diffTs, lag(diffTs), 0),
    residualTs = diffTs / nReps
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

pre15 <- inferenceData %>%
  dplyr::filter(session <= 15) %>%
  left_join(
    pre15, by=c("session", "player", "round", "timestamp")
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, round, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    interpolationTs = cumsum(residualTs) - residualTs
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, round) %>%
  mutate(
    referenceUTC = as.POSIXct(
      stringr::str_extract(file, "\\d{8}T\\d{6}Z"),
      format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ",
      tz = "UTC"
    ),
    timestamp = as.numeric(
      difftime(referenceUTC, roundStart, units = "secs")
    ) + (timestamp - first(timestamp)) + interpolationTs + medianClockOffset
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(referenceUTC, interpolationTs, residualTs, diffTs, nReps))

startStatsPre <- pre15 %>%
  group_by(session, player, round) %>%
  summarise(
    start = first(timestamp)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    meanStart = mean(start, na.rm=TRUE),
    medianStart = median(start, na.rm=TRUE),
  )  

startStatsPre <- startStatsPre %>%
  pull(medianStart)

pre15$timestamp <- pre15$timestamp + medianStartPost - startStatsPre

inferenceData <- dplyr::bind_rows(pre15, post15) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(meanClockOffset, medianClockOffset))

generalOffset <- inferenceData %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    roundTime <= 65
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, round) %>%
  summarise(
    lastDif =  last(timestamp) - last(roundTime)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  summarise(
    medianDif = median(lastDif, na.rm = TRUE),
    meanDif   = mean(lastDif, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

generalOffset <- generalOffset %>%
  pull(medianDif)

inferenceData <- inferenceData %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(timestamp)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = timestamp + 3 - generalOffset
  )

rm(pre15, post15)
```

### DTW

```{r}

shapeDescriptor <- function(x, windowSize) {
  
  stopifnot(windowSize %% 2 == 1)
  
  padding <- (windowSize - 1) / 2
  
  xPadded <- rbind(
    x[rep(1, padding), , drop = FALSE],
    x,
    x[rep(nrow(x), padding), , drop = FALSE]
  )
  
  embed(xPadded, dimension = windowSize)
}

derivDescriptor <- function(x, windowSize, fps) {
  
  do.call(
    cbind,
    lapply(
      seq_len(ncol(x)),
      function(j) {
        signal::sgolayfilt(
          x[, j],
          p = 2,
          n = windowSize,
          m = 1,
          ts = 1 / fps # DEFINE BASED ON REALIZED FPS
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

alignFun <- function(signal1, signal2, timestamps, warpingWindow = 3, fps) {
  
  aligned <- dtw(
    signal1, 
    signal2,
    dist.method = "Euclidean",
    step.pattern = symmetric2,
    window.type = "sakoechiba",
    window.size = fps * warpingWindow, # median fps times allowed warping seconds
    open.begin = FALSE,
    open.end   = FALSE,
    keep = FALSE, # don't store cost matrix
    distance.only = FALSE # don't return only scalar distance
  )
  
  aligned1 <- signal1[aligned$index1, , drop=FALSE]
  aligned2 <- signal2[aligned$index2, , drop=FALSE]
  
  pathIndex <- pmax(
    aligned$index1,
    aligned$index2
  )
  
  return(
    list(
      distance = aligned$normalizedDistance, 
      path = unname(sqrt(rowSums((aligned1 - aligned2)^2))),
      pathTimestamps = timestamps[pathIndex],
      step = aligned$stepsTaken,
      warpingWindow = warpingWindow
    )
  )
}

dtwFun <- function(signal1, signal2, timestamps, type="standard", warpingWindow=3, descriptorWindow=3, fps) {
  
  if (type=="standard") {
    
    aligned <- alignFun(signal1, signal2, timestamps, warpingWindow, fps)
    
  } else if (type=="shape") {
    
    shape1 <- shapeDescriptor(signal1, descriptorWindow)
    
    shape2 <- shapeDescriptor(signal2, descriptorWindow)
    
    aligned <- alignFun(shape1, shape2, timestamps, warpingWindow, fps)
    
  } else if (type=="derivative") {
    
    derivative1 <- derivDescriptor(signal1, descriptorWindow, fps)
    
    derivative2 <- derivDescriptor(signal2, descriptorWindow, fps)
    
    aligned <- alignFun(derivative1, derivative2, timestamps, warpingWindow, fps)
    
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  return(aligned)
}
```

```{r}

alignAvatar <- function(id, data, type, warpingWindow=3, windowTime=0.1) {
  
  dataPlayer <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      playerID == id, 
      !is.na(avatarSmile), 
      !is.na(Happy)
    )
  
  roundTime <- dataPlayer$roundTime[1]
  agreement <- dataPlayer$agreement[1]
  
  
  medianFPS <- dataPlayer %>%
    mutate(
      fps = 1 / (timestamp - lag(timestamp))
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      medianFPS = median(fps, na.rm=TRUE)
    ) %>%
    pull(medianFPS)
  
  signalPlayer <- as.matrix(dataPlayer$Happy)
  signalAvatar <- as.matrix(dataPlayer$avatarSmile)
  timestamps   <- dataPlayer$timestamp
  
  windowRaw <- medianFPS * windowTime
  windowFrames <- as.integer(
    2 * round((windowRaw - 1) / 2) + 1
  ) # Round to closest odd
  
  realizedWindowTime <- windowFrames / medianFPS
  realizedWindowTime
  
  aligned <- dtwFun(signalPlayer, signalAvatar, timestamps=timestamps, type, warpingWindow, descriptorWindow=windowFrames, fps=medianFPS)
  
  result <- list(list(aligned=aligned))
  
  names(result) <- type
  
  return(list(playerID=id, roundTime=roundTime, agreement=agreement, windowTime=realizedWindowTime, aligned=aligned))
}
```

## Run alignment

```{r}

inferenceData <- inferenceData %>%
  arrange(
    session, player, round, timestamp
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    playerID = paste0(session, player, round)
  )

uniqueIDs <- unique(inferenceData$playerID)

dtwType <- "shape"
windowTime <- 0.1 # Descriptor window in seconds 
warpingSeconds <- 3 # Seconds of warping allowed

dtwResults <- pbmclapply(
  uniqueIDs,
  alignAvatar,
  data=inferenceData,
  type=dtwType,
  warpingWindow=warpingSeconds,
  windowTime=windowTime,
  mc.cores = 15,
  mc.preschedule = FALSE
)

resultsPath <- "../Datasets/dtwResultsAvatar.rds"

storedResults <- if (file.exists(resultsPath)) {
  readRDS(resultsPath)
} else {
  list()
}

for (i in seq_along(dtwResults)) {
  if (i > length(storedResults)) {
    storedResults[i] <- dtwResults[i]
    storedResults[[i]][["aligned"]] <- list()
  }
  storedResults[[i]][["aligned"]][[dtwType]] <-
    dtwResults[[i]][["aligned"]]
}

saveRDS(storedResults, file = resultsPath)
```

### DTW summary

```{r}

dtwProcessFun <- function(dtwData) {
  dtwSummary <- do.call(
    dplyr::bind_rows,
    lapply(
      dtwData,
      function(playerData) {
        results <- do.call(
          dplyr::bind_rows,
          lapply(
            names(playerData$aligned),
            function(typeName) {
              
              roundTime <- playerData$roundTime
              agreement <- playerData$agreement
              path      <- playerData$aligned[[typeName]]$path
              weights   <- c(2, ifelse(playerData$aligned[[typeName]]$step==1, 2, 1))
              ts        <- playerData$aligned[[typeName]]$pathTimestamps
              playerID  <- playerData[["playerID"]]
              
              preMask  <- ts <= roundTime
              postMask <- agreement == 1 & ts > roundTime
              
              preDTW <- if (any(preMask)) {
                sum(weights[preMask] * path[preMask]) / sum(weights[preMask])
              } else {
                NA_real_
              }
              
              postDTW <- if (any(postMask)) {
                sum(weights[postMask] * path[postMask]) / sum(weights[postMask])
              } else {
                NA_real_
              }
              
              result <- tibble(
                playerID    = playerData[["playerID"]],
                type      = typeName,
                PreDTW  = preDTW,
                PostDTW = postDTW
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
  
  dtwSummary <- as.data.frame(dtwSummary)
  
  return(dtwSummary)
}
```

```{r}

resultsPath <- "../Datasets/dtwResultsAvatar.rds"

storedResults <- readRDS(resultsPath)

dtwDf <- dtwProcessFun(storedResults) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = playerID,
    names_from = type,
    values_from = c(PreDTW, PostDTW),
    names_glue = "{substr(type, 1, 5)}{.value}"
  )

saveRDS(dtwDf, file = "../Datasets/dataAvatarDTW.rds")
```

### DTW long

```{r}

dtwLongFun <- function(halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25, dtwData) {
  dtwLong <- do.call(
    dplyr::bind_rows,
    lapply(
      dtwData,
      function(playerData) {
        results <- do.call(
          dplyr::bind_rows,
          lapply(
            names(playerData$aligned),
            function(typeName) {
              roundTime <- playerData$roundTime
              agreement <- playerData$agreement
              path      <- playerData$aligned[[typeName]]$path
              weights   <- c(2, ifelse(playerData$aligned[[typeName]]$step==1, 2, 1))
              ts        <- playerData$aligned[[typeName]]$pathTimestamps
              playerID  <- playerData[["playerID"]]
              
              H <- halfLife # Half-life
              tau <- H / log(2)
              EMA <- c()
              tsEMA <- c()
              i <- 1
              
              while (i <= length(ts)) {
                descriptorMask <- ts == ts[i]
                descriptor <- sqrt(
                  sum(weights[descriptorMask]*(path[descriptorMask])^2) / 
                    sum(weights[descriptorMask])
                )
                if (length(EMA) == 0) {
                  update <- descriptor
                } else {
                  dt <- ts[i] - tsEMA[length(tsEMA)]
                  alpha <- 1 - exp(-dt / tau)
                  update <- EMA[length(EMA)] + alpha * (descriptor - EMA[length(EMA)])
                }
                EMA <- append(EMA, update)
                tsEMA <- append(tsEMA, ts[i])
                
                i <- i + sum(descriptorMask)
              }
              
              roundStart <- 0
              
              startTimes <- seq(roundStart, roundTime, by=riskWindow)
              startTimes <- startTimes[startTimes < roundTime]
              endTimes <- c(startTimes[-1], roundTime)
              sampledPath <- c()
              
              for (t in startTimes) {
                
                leftCandidates <- tsEMA[tsEMA <= t]
                rightCandidates <- tsEMA[tsEMA > t]
                
                if (length(leftCandidates) == 0) {
                  
                  sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, NA)
                  
                } else {
                  
                  leftLimit <- max(leftCandidates)
                  
                  if (t - leftLimit > H) {
                    
                    sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, NA)
                    
                  } else if (length(rightCandidates) == 0) {
                    
                    leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, tsEMA)]
                    sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, leftEMA)
                    
                  } else {
                    
                    rightLimit <- min(rightCandidates)
                    
                    if (rightLimit - t > H) {
                      
                      leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, tsEMA)]
                      sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, leftEMA)
                      
                    } else {
                      
                      weight <- (rightLimit - t) /
                        (rightLimit - leftLimit)
                      
                      leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, tsEMA)]
                      rightEMA <- EMA[match(rightLimit, tsEMA)]
                      
                      weightedEMA <- weight * leftEMA +
                        (1 - weight) * rightEMA
                      
                      sampledPath <- c(sampledPath, weightedEMA)
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
              
              result <- tibble(
                playerID  = playerID,
                type      = typeName,
                halfLife  = halfLife,
                valueEMA  = sampledPath,
                startTime = startTimes,
                endTime   = endTimes,
                agreement = as.integer(
                  agreement == 1 &
                    seq_along(startTimes) == length(startTimes)
                )
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
  
  dtwLong <- as.data.frame(dtwLong)
  
  return(dtwLong)
}
```

```{r}

resultsPath <- "../Datasets/dtwResultsAvatar.rds"

storedResults <- readRDS(resultsPath)

dfPath <- "../Datasets/dataAvatarLongDTW.rds"

halfLife <- c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20)

dtwLong <- do.call(
  dplyr::bind_rows,
  pbmclapply(
    halfLife,
    dtwLongFun,
    riskWindow = 0.25,
    dtwData = storedResults,
    mc.cores = length(halfLife)
  )
)

dtwLong <- dtwLong %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(playerID, startTime, endTime, agreement),
    names_from = c(type, halfLife),
    values_from = valueEMA,
    names_glue = "{substr(type, 1, 5)}EMA_HL{halfLife}s"
  )

saveRDS(dtwLong, file = dfPath)
```

### Smiles long

```{r}

funEMA <- function(signal, ts, tau) {
  
  EMA <- numeric(length(signal))
  EMA[1] <- signal[1]
  
  for (i in 2:length(signal)) {
    dt <- ts[i] - ts[i - 1]
    alpha <- 1 - exp(-dt / tau)
    
    EMA[i] <- EMA[i - 1] +
      alpha * (signal[i] - EMA[i - 1])
  }
  
  EMA
}

smoothTs <- function(halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25, df, session, player, roundNum, roundTime, agreement) {
  
  ts <- df$timestamp
  
  H <- halfLife # Half-life
  tau <- H / log(2)
  
  playerSeries <- df$Happy
  avatarSeries <- df$avatarSmile
  
  playerEMA <- funEMA(playerSeries, ts, tau)
  avatarEMA <- funEMA(avatarSeries, ts, tau)
  
  roundStart <- 0
  startTimes <- seq(roundStart, roundTime, by=riskWindow)
  startTimes <- startTimes[startTimes < roundTime]
  endTimes <- c(startTimes[-1], roundTime)
  sampledPlayerEMA <- c()
  sampledAvatarEMA <- c()
  
  for (t in startTimes) {
    
    leftCandidates <- ts[ts <= t]
    rightCandidates <- ts[ts > t]
    
    if (length(leftCandidates) == 0) {
      
      sampledPlayerEMA <- c(sampledPlayerEMA, NA)
      sampledAvatarEMA <- c(sampledAvatarEMA, NA)
      
    } else {
      
      leftLimit <- max(leftCandidates)
      
      if (t - leftLimit > H) {
        
        sampledPlayerEMA <- c(sampledPlayerEMA, NA)
        sampledAvatarEMA <- c(sampledAvatarEMA, NA)
        
      } else if (length(rightCandidates) == 0) {
        
        leftplayerEMA <- playerEMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
        sampledPlayerEMA <- c(sampledPlayerEMA, leftplayerEMA)
        
        leftAvatarEMA <- avatarEMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
        sampledAvatarEMA <- c(sampledAvatarEMA, leftAvatarEMA)
        
      } else {
        
        rightLimit <- min(rightCandidates)
        
        if (rightLimit - t > H) {
          
          leftplayerEMA <- playerEMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
          sampledPlayerEMA <- c(sampledPlayerEMA, leftplayerEMA)
          
          leftAvatarEMA <- avatarEMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
          sampledAvatarEMA <- c(sampledAvatarEMA, leftAvatarEMA)
          
        } else {
          
          weight <- (rightLimit - t) / (rightLimit - leftLimit)
          
          leftplayerEMA <- playerEMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
          rightPlayerEMA <- playerEMA[match(rightLimit, ts)]
          
          weightedPlayerEMA <- weight * leftplayerEMA + (1 - weight) * rightPlayerEMA
          
          sampledPlayerEMA <- c(sampledPlayerEMA, weightedPlayerEMA)
          
          
          leftAvatarEMA <- avatarEMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
          rightAvatarEMA <- avatarEMA[match(rightLimit, ts)]
          
          weightedAvatarEMA <- weight * leftAvatarEMA + (1 - weight) * rightAvatarEMA
          
          sampledAvatarEMA <- c(sampledAvatarEMA, weightedAvatarEMA)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  result <- tibble(
    session = session,
    player = player,
    round = roundNum,
    halfLife = halfLife,
    playerEMA = sampledPlayerEMA,
    avatarEMA = sampledAvatarEMA,
    startTime = startTimes,
    endTime = endTimes,
    agreement = as.integer(
      agreement == 1 &
        seq_along(startTimes) == length(startTimes)
    )
  )
  
}

masterEMA <- function(id, halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25, data) {
  
  dataPlayer <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      playerID == id,
      is.finite(timestamp),
      !is.na(avatarSmile),
      !is.na(Happy)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(timestamp)
  
  if (nrow(dataPlayer) == 0L) {
    stop("No usable observations for playerID: ", id)
  }
  
  session   <- dataPlayer$session[1]
  player    <- dataPlayer$player[1]
  roundNum  <- dataPlayer$round[1]
  roundTime <- dataPlayer$roundTime[1]
  agreement <- dataPlayer$agreement[1]
  
  do.call(
    dplyr::bind_rows,
    lapply(
      halfLife,
      smoothTs,
      riskWindow=riskWindow,
      df=dataPlayer,
      session=session,
      player=player,
      roundNum=roundNum,
      roundTime=roundTime, 
      agreement=agreement
    )
  )
}  
```

```{r}
  pbmclapply(
    uniqueIDs,
    masterEMA,
    halfLife = c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20),
    riskWindow = 0.25,
    data = inferenceData,
    mc.cores = 15
  )
)

smileLong <- smileLong %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(session, player, round, startTime, endTime, agreement),
    names_from = halfLife,
    values_from = c(playerEMA, avatarEMA),
    names_glue = "{.value}_HL{halfLife}s"
  )

saveRDS(smileLong, file = "../Datasets/dataAvatarLongSmiles.rds")
```

## Plot

```{r}

quantize <- 2 # 0.5 seconds

dataTrajectory <- inferenceData %>%
  dplyr::filter( !( is.na(experimental) | is.na(avatarSmile) | is.na(Happy) ) ) %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp = ceiling(timestamp*quantize)
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, round, timestamp) %>%
  summarise(
    Start = first(timestamp)/quantize,
    Agreement = first(timestamp)/quantize - first(roundTime),
    Avatar = mean(avatarSmile),
    Participant = mean(Happy),
    Experimental = first(experimental)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Start, Agreement),
    names_to = "Center",
    values_to = "Timestamp"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Avatar, Participant),
    names_to = "Individual",
    values_to = "Smile"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Center = as.factor(Center)
  )
  
smileTrajectoryPlot <- ggplot(
  data = dataTrajectory,
  aes(x = Timestamp, y = Smile, group = Individual, color = Individual, fill = Individual)
) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = 0.05, 
    alpha = 0.1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = dataTrajectory %>%
      group_by(Center, Experimental, Individual) %>%
      summarise(meanSmile = mean(Smile, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
    aes(yintercept = meanSmile, color = Individual),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
#    color = "grey30"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "gam",
    formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs", k = 25),
    method.args = list(method = "REML"),
    se = FALSE,
    linewidth = 1,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    Center ~ Experimental,
    scales = "free_x",
    independent = "x",
    labeller = labeller(
      Experimental = c("0" = "Control", "1" = "Treatment")
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Individual",
    values = c("Avatar" = "darkgoldenrod1", "Participant" = "dodgerblue2")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Individual",
    values = c("Avatar" = "darkgoldenrod1", "Participant" = "dodgerblue2")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 0.35), 
    expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
#    title = "Treatment differences in smiling trajectories",
    x = "Round time",
    y = "Smile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(
    base_family = "serif",
    base_size = 10
  ) +
#  guides(shape = "none") +
  theme(
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 8,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 9,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 9,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


smileTrajectoryPlot

ggsave(
  "../Plots/smileTrajectoryPlot.pdf",
  plot = smileTrajectoryPlot,
  device = "pdf",
  width = 7,
  height = 4.6,
  units = "in",
  useDingbats = FALSE
)

ggsave(
  "../Plots/smileTrajectoryPlot.png",
  plot = smileTrajectoryPlot,
  width = 7,
  height = 4.6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
